name: nocodb-ops
description: NocoDB ops plugin for Agents Store. Record management, filtering (structured filters, exactDate date filters), sorting, reports, search, webhooks (events, payload, conditions), and data import/export for business users via the NocoDB MCP server (writes in batches of up to 100 records; extra tools on Cloud/licensed through listTools/callTool) and curl on the v3 API.
